protocol.question: Does adding a licensed adversarial paraphrase task improve transfer beyond relation training?

selection.paws: Per official split, first fixed input hashes within each label; 768 train, 96 validation, 192 test
selection.boolq: First 384 token-admissible SHA-256(question, passage); answer excluded
selection.winogrande: Byte-identical previously frozen 384-case set; never training data

protocol.budget: Per seed: 768 PAWS-Wiki + 256 old replay rows, one epoch, 128 updates, one view
protocol.objective: Clean CE + 0.5 Brier; fresh optimizer; seed-specific balanced relation checkpoint start
protocol.checkpoint_selection: All two final endpoints fixed before blind inference; no early stopping or winner selection
limitations: WinoGrande was inspected in the preceding study; BoolQ is the new score-blind task family
Public pretrained base contamination cannot be excluded
